verdict.gold_reason: Article 20(6) says the platform for manually activated frequency restoration reserves must be implemented 30 months after approval of the implementation framework, or 12 months after approval of a modification proposal if one is submitted under paragraph 5. The reference answer states exactly this.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is heavily paraphrased ('back-up power that a dispatcher orders by hand'). It still maps clearly to frequency restoration reserves with manual activation. Article 21 has the same timelines but covers automatic activation, and Article 19 covers replacement reserves with a one-year deadline.
